mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and profit pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 2% for three consecutive months signals improving manufacturing activity and earnings momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when INDPRO exceeds 2% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 3% for three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 0.5% for two consecutive months signals robust labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when PAYEMS exceeds 0.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 3% for two consecutive quarters signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when GDPC1 exceeds 3% for two quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below -1% for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity and earnings pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO is below -1% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
